# Instant

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Instant`](gmeow-Instant.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Instant>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A zero-duration point in time, distinct from a [`TimeInterval`](gmeow-TimeInterval.md). Carries a crisp [`instantValue`](../properties/gmeow-instantValue.md) ([xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)) and/or an [`edtfValue`](../properties/gmeow-edtfValue.md) (EDTF literal) relative to a [`TemporalFrame`](gmeow-TemporalFrame.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:AbstractIndividual`](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#AbstractIndividual)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Instant`](gmeow-Instant.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:AbstractIndividual`](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#AbstractIndividual). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a zero-duration point that must itself bear a frame, a granularity, a determinacy, or an EDTF approximation — the reified point that a [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](gmeow-TimeInterval.md) endpoint or a [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](gmeow-NamedPeriod.md) boundary references.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for an inline timestamp that needs no facets (use [`gmeow:atTime`](../properties/gmeow-atTime.md) or [`gmeow:startedAtTime`](../properties/gmeow-startedAtTime.md)) and for a bounded span (use [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](gmeow-TimeInterval.md)); an [`Instant`](gmeow-Instant.md) is the heavyweight, facet-bearing point.

### How to use

- Give it a crisp [`gmeow:instantValue`](../properties/gmeow-instantValue.md) ([xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime), P3) and/or an approximate [`gmeow:edtfValue`](../properties/gmeow-edtfValue.md), declare its [`gmeow:inTemporalFrame`](../properties/gmeow-inTemporalFrame.md) (P11), and attach [`gmeow:hasGranularity`](../properties/gmeow-hasGranularity.md) / [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](../properties/gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md) when the resolution or determinacy is below crisp-to-the-second.

### Examples

- ex:birthInstant a [`gmeow:Instant`](gmeow-Instant.md); [`gmeow:instantValue`](../properties/gmeow-instantValue.md) "1804-07-12T00:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); [`gmeow:inTemporalFrame`](../properties/gmeow-inTemporalFrame.md) [`gmeow:temporalFrameUTCGregorian`](../individuals/gmeow-temporalFrameUTCGregorian.md); [`gmeow:hasGranularity`](../properties/gmeow-hasGranularity.md) [`gmeow:granularityDay`](../individuals/gmeow-granularityDay.md).
